bull_case: Mounjaro/Zepbound continue global expansion while orforglipron and retatrutide extend the incretin franchise, manufacturing constraints ease, and owner FCF/share compounds toward $150 by year 10.
bear_case: Tirzepatide growth decelerates sharply under competition and pricing pressure, pipeline successors underperform, and elevated manufacturing/R&D/acquisition reinvestment keeps owner FCF well below current market expectations.
thesis: At $1,164.89, LLY trades at about 0.91x the locked Base value of $1,282.74. The price does not require the Bull case, but Base itself assumes a long runway of high-teens owner-FCF/share compounding from a ~$20 TTM proxy toward $113 by year 10. Mounjaro/Zepbound concentration and pharmaceutical reinvestment make the valuation less robust than the headline price/Base discount suggests.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $22.974B, up 48% YoY, and net income was $7.095B; H1 revenue was $42.773B and net income $14.491B.
FY2025 CFO-capex was about $8.97B. Using FY2025 plus H1 2026 less H1 2025 gives a TTM CFO-capex proxy of about $18.19B, or ~$20.35/share on Q2 diluted shares.
Q2 Mounjaro revenue was $9.943B and Zepbound $4.928B, together about 64.7% of quarterly revenue.

Q2 filing states orforglipron was FDA-approved for obesity and retatrutide Phase 3 obesity and type 2 diabetes trials met primary endpoints, extending the potential metabolic pipeline beyond tirzepatide.
At June 30, cash plus investments were $12.806B versus $54.908B short/current and long-term debt, giving conservative net debt of about $42.10B or $47.11/share.
Locked 9%/10-year DCF values are about $345.26 Bear, $1,282.74 Base and $2,016.84 Bull; price/Base is 0.9081x.
evidence.source: Harness locked owner-FCF/share DCF using frozen 2026-09-21 inputs

counterevidence: Q2/H1 growth is unusually strong and current manufacturing expansion may create substantial future operating leverage once capacity catches demand.
Orforglipron approval and positive retatrutide Phase 3 results reduce dependence on tirzepatide as a single molecule over the long run.
H1 2026 operating cash flow rebounded sharply, suggesting current owner-cash conversion may be inflecting faster than the FY2025 base indicates.
Current price remains below the locked Base value and far below Bull, so the market is not explicitly pricing a Bull-plus outcome.
unknowns: Normalized maintenance versus growth capex after the current manufacturing buildout.
Long-run realized pricing and rebate intensity for incretins in the U.S. and major reimbursed markets.
Commercial cannibalization versus expansion among tirzepatide, orforglipron and retatrutide.
Full economic return on acquired IPR&D and recent acquisitions.
A reproducible five-year valuation percentile using a consistent owner-earnings metric.
falsifiers: Owner FCF/share fails to move toward the Base path as major new manufacturing capacity comes online.
Tirzepatide volume growth slows materially while realized pricing pressure accelerates and successor assets fail to offset it.
A refrozen valuation using updated pipeline/cash-flow evidence produces Base value materially below market price.
